Name: Lakoria's Vibrant Hair for Get Glam
Author: Faedelity
Description:
This is a Get Glam pack of Lakoria's Vibrant Hair, both the Mild and Ultra versions, converted from the original xnb mod. If you like some of the vanilla hairstyles, but wish they were a bit more vivid, this is a great collection of hairstyles.

The pictures show the difference between Vanilla, Mild, and Ultra on one hairstyle and the hairstyles included in the pack (scaled up for easier viewing). The actual hairstyles are the same between Mild and Ultra. It is only the shading that changes.

This pack is posted with permission, and you can find the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39]here[/url]. The texture work was all done by Lakoria, the Get Glam reformat was done by Faedelity.

In order to use these, you will need the Get Glam mod (listed in the requirements). Once you have that installed, simply unzip this into your mod folder, and you will be able to access the new hairstyles using Get Glam (check the Get Glam mod page if you have any difficulties).
